readme.note: Full generate-view data set: one realistically-named, sensibly-connected Part for every element type used by ANY of Advanced > Generate View's 13 view definitions (not just what Generate Industry itself would produce) — so running Advanced > Generate View (Select All) against this model's "Reference" data immediately produces all 13 views fully populated, with no "Parts Needed" marker anywhere. See the yellow "About This Data Set" note on this view for exactly how it was generated, so you can ask an AI assistant to regenerate or extend it later.

parts.label: About This Data Set
parts.description: How this data set was generated (ask an AI assistant this to regenerate or extend it): "Not restricted to parts from Generate Industry, create a full data set of any industry that will have all parts needed for all the Advanced > Generate View views." Concretely: read GENERATE_VIEW_GROUPS in js/commands.js for the current list of 13 view definitions, each with requiredTypes/optionalTypes (ArchiMate element types from public/custom.json's elements list). Create at least one realistically-named Part of every required AND optional type across all 13 definitions (union: BusinessActor, BusinessRole, BusinessOrganizationUnit, BusinessCollaboration, BusinessCapability, Capability, BusinessProcess, BusinessEvent, BusinessService, BusinessFunction, BusinessObject, DataDataEntity, DataEntityDetails, DataLogicalComponent, ApplicationApplication, ApplicationInterface, ApplicationService, ApplicationLogicalComponent, ApplicationPhysicalComponent, ApplicationCapability, ApplicationFunction, ApplicationProcess, ApplicationCollaboration, ApplicationInteraction, ApplicationEvent, Node, Device, SystemSoftware, Equipment, Facility, TechnologyPhysicalComponent, TechnologyLogicalComponent, CommunicationNetwork, DistributionNetwork, Path, TechnologyService, TechnologyInterface, Constraint, Requirement, Principle, Driver, Goal), all in one model. Connect related pairs with plain 'c' (connectorType) Connectors, deliberately reusing shared types across different views' definitions (e.g. Node/Device/ApplicationApplication each appear in several views) so every view ends up with genuine internal connectivity, not isolated nodes. Running Advanced > Generate Industry then Advanced > Generate View (Select All) against this model should produce all 13 views fully populated, with no "<view> Parts Needed" marker on any of them.
